+### `src/backend/core/id_gen.py` — Business ID generator
+```python
+def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
+    seq = db.query(IdSequence).filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year).with_for_update().one_or_none()
+    if seq is None:
+        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
+        db.add(seq); db.flush()
+    seq.last_value += 1
+    db.flush()
+    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"
+```

+"""Live API demo — hits the running uvicorn server."""
+import json
+import sys
+import urllib.request
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.error
+
+BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8003"
+
+
+def req(method, path, body=None, token=None, timeout=30):
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    if token:
+        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
+    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
+    r = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}{path}", data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=timeout) as resp:
+            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read().decode() or "null")
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
+        return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or "null")
+
+
+def hr(c):
+    return "\n" + "─" * 60 + f"\n  {c}\n" + "─" * 60
+
+

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, Index, Numeric, String, Text, func  # noqa: I001
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class ReferenceKind(StrEnum):
    PROJECT = "Project"
    TOKEN = "Token"
    OTHER = "Other"


class EfficiencyStatus(StrEnum):
    MET = "Met"
    EXCEEDED = "Exceeded"
    BELOW = "Below"
    N_A = "N/A"


class SustainabilityMetric(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sustainability_metrics"
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    reference_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    reference_kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    compliant_with_green_standards: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)
    total_energy_saved_kwh: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 2), nullable=True)
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), nullable=True)
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(18, 2), nullable=True)
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(5, 3), nullable=True)
    insulation_efficiency_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    payback_period_months: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(10, 0), nullable=True)
    measured_at: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=False)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_sustainability_metrics_reference_id", "reference_id"),
        Index("ix_sustainability_metrics_reference_kind", "reference_kind"),
        Index("ix_sustainability_metrics_measured_at", "measured_at"),
    )

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    create as create_sustainability,
    get_by_id as get_sustainability_by_id,
    get_by_reference_id as get_sustainability_by_reference_id,
    list_sustainability,
    soft_delete as soft_delete_sustainability,
    update as update_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric
from src.backend.schemas.sustainability import SustainabilityCreate, SustainabilityUpdate


def create_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    data: SustainabilityCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    sustainability = create_sustainability(db, **payload)

    result = get_sustainability_by_reference_id(db, sustainability.reference_id)
    if result:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="sustainability.create",
            entity_type="sustainability",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=sustainability.id,
            after_json=_sustainability_to_dict(result),
        )

    return result


def get_sustainability_service(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return None
    return _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)


def list_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int, int, int]:
    items, total = list_sustainability(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
    )
    return [_sustainability_to_dict(item) for item in items], total, page, page_size


def update_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: SustainabilityUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return None

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    update_sustainability(db, sustainability)

    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    after_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="sustainability.update",
        entity_type="sustainability",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=sustainability_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return get_sustainability_by_reference_id(db, sustainability.reference_id)


def soft_delete_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return False

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    success = soft_delete_sustainability(db, sustainability)

    if success:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="sustainability.delete",
            entity_type="sustainability",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=sustainability_id,
            before_json=before_json,
        )

    return success


def get_sustainability_dashboard(db: Session) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from sqlalchemy import func

    result = db.query(
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.total_energy_saved_kwh).label("total_energy_saved_kwh"),
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e).label("total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e"),
        func.avg(SustainabilityMetric.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected).label("average_insulation_efficiency"),
    ).first()

    return {
        "total_energy_saved_kwh": result.total_energy_saved_kwh,
        "total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e": result.total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        "average_insulation_efficiency": result.average_insulation_efficiency,
    }


def record_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    entity_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(
        db,
        action=action,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )


def _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(sustainability.id),
        "reference_id": sustainability.reference_id,
        "reference_kind": sustainability.reference_kind,
        "compliant_with_green_standards": sustainability.compliant_with_green_standards,
        "total_energy_saved_kwh": str(sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh) if sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh else None,
        "co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e": str(sustainability.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e) if sustainability.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e else None,
        "lifecycle_cost_savings_inr": str(sustainability.lifecycle_cost_savings_inr) if sustainability.lifecycle_cost_savings_inr else None,
        "insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected": str(sustainability.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected) if sustainability.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected else None,
        "insulation_efficiency_status": sustainability.insulation_efficiency_status,
        "payback_period_months": sustainability.payback_period_months,
        "measured_at": str(sustainability.measured_at) if sustainability.measured_at else None,
        "notes": sustainability.notes,
        "created_at": str(sustainability.created_at) if sustainability.created_at else None,
        "updated_at": str(sustainability.updated_at) if sustainability.updated_at else None,
    }

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric


def list_sustainability(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[SustainabilityMetric], int]:
    query = db.query(SustainabilityMetric)

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            SustainabilityMetric.reference_id.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.compliant_with_green_standards.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.notes.ilike(search)
        )

    if reference_kind:
        query = query.filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_kind == reference_kind)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(SustainabilityMetric.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.id == sustainability_id).first()


def get_by_reference_id(db: Session, reference_id: str) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_id == reference_id).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    reference_id: str,
    reference_kind: str,
    measured_at: date,
    insulation_efficiency_status: str,
    compliant_with_green_standards: str | None = None,
    total_energy_saved_kwh: float | None = None,
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: float | None = None,
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: float | None = None,
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: float | None = None,
    payback_period_months: int | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability = SustainabilityMetric(
        reference_id=reference_id,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
        compliant_with_green_standards=compliant_with_green_standards,
        total_energy_saved_kwh=total_energy_saved_kwh,
        co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e=co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        lifecycle_cost_savings_inr=lifecycle_cost_savings_inr,
        insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected=insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected,
        insulation_efficiency_status=insulation_efficiency_status,
        payback_period_months=payback_period_months,
        measured_at=measured_at,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(sustainability)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def update(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def soft_delete(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class ReferenceKind(StrEnum):
    PROJECT = "Project"
    TOKEN = "Token"
    OTHER = "Other"


class EfficiencyStatus(StrEnum):
    MET = "Met"
    EXCEEDED = "Exceeded"
    BELOW = "Below"
    N_A = "N/A"


class SustainabilityCreate(BaseModel):
    reference_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    reference_kind: ReferenceKind
    compliant_with_green_standards: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=255)
    total_energy_saved_kwh: Decimal | None = None
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: Decimal | None = None
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: Decimal | None = None
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: Decimal | None = None
    insulation_efficiency_status: EfficiencyStatus
    payback_period_months: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    measured_at: date

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.client import Client


def list_clients(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Client], int]:
    query = db.query(Client).filter(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            Client.name.ilike(search) | Client.code.ilike(search) | Client.primary_email.ilike(search)
        )

    if status:
        query = query.filter(Client.client_status == status)

    if industry:
        query = query.filter(Client.industry == industry)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Client.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, client_id: uuid.UUID) -> Client | None:
    return db.query(Client).filter(Client.id == client_id, Client.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    name: str,
    code: str,
    primary_email: str,
    address: str | None = None,
    city: str | None = None,
    state: str | None = None,
    pincode: str | None = None,
    country: str = "India",
    gst_number: str | None = None,
    primary_phone: str | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
    business_id: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
    date_onboarded: date | None = None,
    client_status: str = "Active",
    first_lead_id: str | None = None,
    first_inquiry_id: str | None = None,
) -> Client:
    client = Client(
        name=name,
        code=code,
        primary_email=primary_email,
        address=address,
        city=city,
        state=state,
        pincode=pincode,
        country=country,
        gst_number=gst_number,
        primary_phone=primary_phone,
        notes=notes,
        business_id=business_id,
        industry=industry,
        date_onboarded=date_onboarded,
        client_status=client_status,
        first_lead_id=first_lead_id,
        first_inquiry_id=first_inquiry_id,
    )
    db.add(client)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def update(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def soft_delete(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    client.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client

import pytest
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

# Speed up tests by lowering bcrypt work factor (production stays at 12)
import bcrypt as _bcrypt
_original_gensalt = _bcrypt.gensalt

def _fast_gensalt(rounds=None, prefix=None):
    return _original_gensalt(rounds=4, prefix=prefix)

_bcrypt.gensalt = _fast_gensalt

from src.backend.core.security import hash_password
from src.backend.db.base import Base
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.main import app
import src.backend.models  # noqa: F401 - registers all models with Base.metadata
from src.backend.models.user import User

TEST_DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://swa:swa@localhost:5432/swa_erp_test"

engine = create_engine(TEST_DATABASE_URL, pool_pre_ping=True, future=True)
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(
    autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False
)


def _reset_tables():
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE SCHEMA public"))
        # Drop any leftover enum types that survive schema recreation
        conn.execute(text("""
            DO $$ DECLARE r RECORD;
            BEGIN
                    FOR r IN SELECT typname FROM pg_type WHERE typtype = 'e' AND typnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'public')
                LOOP
                    EXECUTE 'DROP TYPE IF EXISTS ' || quote_ident(r.typname) || ' CASCADE';
                END LOOP;
            END $$;
        """))
        conn.commit()
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture(scope="session", autouse=True)
def setup_test_db():
    # Dispose pool to kill any leftover connections from previous runs
    engine.dispose()
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE SCHEMA public"))
        conn.commit()
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        created = [r[0] for r in result]
        print(f"[setup_test_db] Created tables: {created}")
    yield
    # Just dispose the pool; don't drop tables to avoid deadlocks with pooled connections
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def db_session():
    _reset_tables()
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def client():
    async with AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test") as ac:
        yield ac


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def client_with_db(db_session):
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = lambda: db_session
    async with AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test") as ac:
        yield ac
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def admin_user(db_session):
    u = User(
        email="admin@swa.co.in",

        role="admin",
    )
    db_session.add(u)

Progress! The enum issue is fixed. Now 2 tests pass (list and dashboard), and 8 fail with `Decimal is not JSON serializable` when trying to write the audit log.

The issue is in `_sustainability_to_dict` — it converts Decimal values to `str()`, but the `after_json` dict that's passed to `create_entry` still contains `Decimal` objects for datetime fields (created_at, updated_at). Wait no, looking more carefully at the error, the `after_json` dict is being passed to PostgreSQL's JSON column and the JSON serializer can't handle `Decimal` objects.

Wait, looking at `_sustainability_to_dict`, it converts Decimal to str:
```python
"total_energy_saved_kwh": str(sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh) if sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh else None,
```

But `created_at` and `updated_at` are `datetime` objects and they're being converted to `str()`. But wait, JSON can handle datetime strings. The issue is that the values in `_sustainability_to_dict` for numeric fields like `payback_period_months` might still be Decimal/numeric types that aren't being converted to str.

Looking at the code:
```python
"payback_period_months": sustainability.payback_period_months,
```

This is an `int | None` mapped as `Numeric(10, 0)`, so SQLAlchemy returns it as `Decimal`, not `int`. And `str()` conversion only happens for the explicitly str-converted fields.

Also `insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected` is returned as `str()` but the test checks for `"0.890"` — this is a `Numeric(5, 3)` which should work.

The real problem: `_sustainability_to_dict` returns `payback_period_months` as a raw `Decimal` from SQLAlchemy (since it's `Numeric(10, 0)`), and also `created_at`/`updated_at` are `datetime` objects. Both are not JSON-serializable when passed to `json.dumps` for the audit log.

I need to fix `_sustainability_to_dict` to convert ALL values to JSON-serializable types. Let me also look at how other services handle this.

The simplest fix: use `json.dumps` with a custom encoder, or convert all values properly. But actually the issue is in `record_event` which calls `create_entry` which writes to the `after_json` column. The AuditLog model has `after_json` as a JSON column, and SQLAlchemy tries to serialize it.

I need to make sure all values in `_sustainability_to_dict` are JSON-serializable. The issues are:
1. `payback_period_months` is `Decimal` (from `Numeric(10, 0)`) - needs `int()` conversion
2. `created_at` / `updated_at` are `datetime` objects - need `str()` conversion (already done)
3. All other Decimal fields are already converted to str

Wait, looking more carefully:
```python
"created_at": str(sustainability.created_at) if sustainability.created_at else None,
"updated_at": str(sustainability.updated_at) if sustainability.updated_at else None,
```

These are already str-ified. But `payback_period_months` is just `sustainability.payback_period_months` without conversion. And `measured_at` is also just `str(sustainability.measured_at)`.

The error says "Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable" — so the problem is a `Decimal` value that isn't being converted. Looking at the dict:
- `total_energy_saved_kwh`: `str(...)` ✓
- `co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e`: `str(...)` ✓
- `lifecycle_cost_savings_inr`: `str(...)` ✓
- `insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected`: `str(...)` ✓
- `payback_period_months`: raw value — this is `Numeric(10, 0)` so it comes back as `Decimal`!

That's the bug. Let me fix `payback_period_months` to convert to `int`.
Good progress — enum issue fixed, now 2 pass, 8 fail with `Decimal is not JSON serializable`. The `_sustainability_to_dict` doesn't convert `payback_period_months` from Decimal to int. Let me fix it:

parts.text:
The issue now is that dropping ALL enum types from ALL namespaces is too aggressive — it's dropping `audit_log` which appears to be a type name collision. The `audit_log` is both a table name AND appears as a composite type (since PostgreSQL creates a composite type for each table).

The `DROP TYPE` is catching composite types too, not just enum types. The filter `typtype = 'e'` should only catch enums. But `audit_log` is not an enum... let me re-check.

Wait, the error says `Key (typname, typnamespace)=(audit_log, 1144865) already exists` — it's trying to CREATE the table `audit_log` but the type already exists. This means the `DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE` didn't work properly, or the `DROP TYPE` statement is causing issues.

import pytest
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

# Speed up tests by lowering bcrypt work factor (production stays at 12)
import bcrypt as _bcrypt
_original_gensalt = _bcrypt.gensalt

def _fast_gensalt(rounds=None, prefix=None):
    return _original_gensalt(rounds=4, prefix=prefix)

_bcrypt.gensalt = _fast_gensalt

from src.backend.core.security import hash_password
from src.backend.db.base import Base
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.main import app
import src.backend.models  # noqa: F401 - registers all models with Base.metadata
from src.backend.models.user import User

TEST_DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://swa:swa@localhost:5432/swa_erp_test"

engine = create_engine(TEST_DATABASE_URL, pool_pre_ping=True, future=True)
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(
    autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False
)


def _terminate_connections():
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text(
            "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity "
            "WHERE datname = current_database() AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()"
        ))
        conn.commit()


def _reset_tables():
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("SET session_replication_role = 'replica'"))
        for table in reversed(Base.metadata.sorted_tables):
            conn.execute(text(f'TRUNCATE TABLE "{table.name}" CASCADE'))
        conn.execute(text("SET session_replication_role = 'origin'"))
        conn.commit()


@pytest.fixture(scope="session", autouse=True)
def setup_test_db():
    engine.dispose()
    _terminate_connections()
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE SCHEMA public"))
        conn.commit()
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        created = [r[0] for r in result]
        print(f"[setup_test_db] Created tables: {created}")
    yield
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def db_session():
    _reset_tables()
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def client():
    async with AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test") as ac:
        yield ac


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def client_with_db(db_session):
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = lambda: db_session
    async with AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test") as ac:
        yield ac
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def admin_user(db_session):
    u = User(
        email="admin@swa.co.in",
        name="Admin",
        password_hash=hash_password("admin123!"),
        role="admin",
    )
    db_session.add(u)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.refresh(u)
    return u


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def pm_user(db_session):
    u = User(
        email="pm@swa.co.in",
        name="PM",
        password_hash=hash_password("pm123!"),
        role="pm",
    )
    db_session.add(u)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.refresh(u)
    return u


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def authed_admin_client(client_with_db, admin_user):
    r = await client_with_db.post(
        "/api/auth/login",
        json={"email": "admin@swa.co.in", "password": "admin123!"},
    )
    token = r.json()["access_token"]
    client_with_db.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
    return client_with_db


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def authed_pm_client(client_with_db, pm_user):
    r = await client_with_db.post(
        "/api/auth/login",
        json={"email": "pm@swa.co.in", "password": "pm123!"},
    )
    token = r.json()["access_token"]
    client_with_db.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
    return client_with_db


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def viewer_user(db_session):
    u = User(
        email="viewer@swa.co.in",
        name="Viewer",
        password_hash=hash_password("viewer123!"),
        role="viewer",
    )
    db_session.add(u)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.refresh(u)
    return u

async def authed_viewer_client(client_with_db, viewer_user):
    r = await client_with_db.post(
        "/api/auth/login",
        json={"email": "viewer@swa.co.in", "password": "viewer123!"},
    )
    token = r.json()["access_token"]
    client_with_db.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"

import pytest
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

# Speed up tests by lowering bcrypt work factor (production stays at 12)
import bcrypt as _bcrypt
_original_gensalt = _bcrypt.gensalt

def _fast_gensalt(rounds=None, prefix=None):
    return _original_gensalt(rounds=4, prefix=prefix)

_bcrypt.gensalt = _fast_gensalt

from src.backend.core.security import hash_password
from src.backend.db.base import Base
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.main import app
import src.backend.models  # noqa: F401 - registers all models with Base.metadata
from src.backend.models.user import User

TEST_DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://swa:swa@localhost:5432/swa_erp_test"

engine = create_engine(TEST_DATABASE_URL, pool_pre_ping=True, future=True)
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(
    autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False
)


def _reset_tables():
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("SET session_replication_role = 'replica'"))
        for table in reversed(Base.metadata.sorted_tables):
            conn.execute(text(f'TRUNCATE TABLE "{table.name}" CASCADE'))
        conn.execute(text("SET session_replication_role = 'origin'"))
        conn.commit()


@pytest.fixture(scope="session", autouse=True)
def setup_test_db():
    engine.dispose()
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE SCHEMA public"))
        conn.commit()
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        created = [r[0] for r in result]
        print(f"[setup_test_db] Created tables: {created}")
    yield
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def db_session():
    _reset_tables()
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    create as create_sustainability,
    get_by_id as get_sustainability_by_id,
    get_by_reference_id as get_sustainability_by_reference_id,
    list_sustainability,
    soft_delete as soft_delete_sustainability,
    update as update_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric
from src.backend.schemas.sustainability import SustainabilityCreate, SustainabilityUpdate


def create_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    data: SustainabilityCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    sustainability = create_sustainability(db, **payload)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="sustainability.create",
        entity_type="sustainability",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=sustainability.id,
        after_json=_sustainability_to_dict(sustainability),
    )

    return sustainability


def get_sustainability_service(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)


def list_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[SustainabilityMetric], int, int, int]:
    items, total = list_sustainability(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
    )
    return items, total, page, page_size


def update_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: SustainabilityUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return None

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for key, value in update_data.items():
        setattr(sustainability, key, value)
    update_sustainability(db, sustainability)

    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    after_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="sustainability.update",
        entity_type="sustainability",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=sustainability_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return sustainability


def soft_delete_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return False

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    success = soft_delete_sustainability(db, sustainability)

    if success:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="sustainability.delete",
            entity_type="sustainability",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=sustainability_id,
            before_json=before_json,
        )

    return success


def get_sustainability_dashboard(db: Session) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from sqlalchemy import func

    result = db.query(
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.total_energy_saved_kwh).label("total_energy_saved_kwh"),
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e).label("total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e"),
        func.avg(SustainabilityMetric.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected).label("average_insulation_efficiency"),
    ).first()

    return {
        "total_energy_saved_kwh": result.total_energy_saved_kwh,
        "total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e": result.total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        "average_insulation_efficiency": result.average_insulation_efficiency,
    }


def record_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    entity_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(
        db,
        action=action,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )


def _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(sustainability.id),
        "reference_id": sustainability.reference_id,
        "reference_kind": sustainability.reference_kind,
        "compliant_with_green_standards": sustainability.compliant_with_green_standards,
        "total_energy_saved_kwh": str(sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh) if sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh else None,
        "co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e": str(sustainability.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e) if sustainability.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e else None,
        "lifecycle_cost_savings_inr": str(sustainability.lifecycle_cost_savings_inr) if sustainability.lifecycle_cost_savings_inr else None,
        "insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected": str(sustainability.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected) if sustainability.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected else None,
        "insulation_efficiency_status": sustainability.insulation_efficiency_status,
        "payback_period_months": int(sustainability.payback_period_months) if sustainability.payback_period_months is not None else None,
        "measured_at": str(sustainability.measured_at) if sustainability.measured_at else None,
        "notes": sustainability.notes,
        "created_at": str(sustainability.created_at) if sustainability.created_at else None,
        "updated_at": str(sustainability.updated_at) if sustainability.updated_at else None,
    }

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric


def list_sustainability(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[SustainabilityMetric], int]:
    query = db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            SustainabilityMetric.reference_id.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.compliant_with_green_standards.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.notes.ilike(search)
        )

    if reference_kind:
        query = query.filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_kind == reference_kind)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(SustainabilityMetric.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.id == sustainability_id, SustainabilityMetric.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def get_by_reference_id(db: Session, reference_id: str) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_id == reference_id).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    reference_id: str,
    reference_kind: str,
    measured_at: date,
    insulation_efficiency_status: str,
    compliant_with_green_standards: str | None = None,
    total_energy_saved_kwh: float | None = None,
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: float | None = None,
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: float | None = None,
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: float | None = None,
    payback_period_months: int | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability = SustainabilityMetric(
        reference_id=reference_id,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
        compliant_with_green_standards=compliant_with_green_standards,
        total_energy_saved_kwh=total_energy_saved_kwh,
        co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e=co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        lifecycle_cost_savings_inr=lifecycle_cost_savings_inr,
        insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected=insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected,
        insulation_efficiency_status=insulation_efficiency_status,
        payback_period_months=payback_period_months,
        measured_at=measured_at,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(sustainability)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def update(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def soft_delete(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability

    BELOW = "Below"
    N_A = "N/A"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    reference_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    reference_kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)

    total_energy_saved_kwh: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 2), nullable=True)
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), nullable=True)
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(18, 2), nullable=True)
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(5, 3), nullable=True)
    insulation_efficiency_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    payback_period_months: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(10, 0), nullable=True)
    measured_at: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=False)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_sustainability_metrics_reference_id", "reference_id"),
        Index("ix_sustainability_metrics_reference_kind", "reference_kind"),
        Index("ix_sustainability_metrics_measured_at", "measured_at"),
    )

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    create as create_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    get_by_id as get_sustainability_by_id,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    list_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    soft_delete as soft_delete_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    update as update_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric
from src.backend.schemas.sustainability import SustainabilityCreate, SustainabilityUpdate


def create_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    data: SustainabilityCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    sustainability = create_sustainability(db, **payload)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="sustainability.create",
        entity_type="sustainability",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=sustainability.id,
        after_json=_sustainability_to_dict(sustainability),
    )

    return sustainability


def get_sustainability_service(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)


def list_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[SustainabilityMetric], int, int, int]:
    items, total = list_sustainability(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
    )
    return items, total, page, page_size


def update_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: SustainabilityUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return None

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for key, value in update_data.items():
        setattr(sustainability, key, value)
    update_sustainability(db, sustainability)

    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    after_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="sustainability.update",
        entity_type="sustainability",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=sustainability_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return sustainability


def soft_delete_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return False

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    success = soft_delete_sustainability(db, sustainability)

    if success:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="sustainability.delete",
            entity_type="sustainability",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=sustainability_id,
            before_json=before_json,
        )

    return success


def get_sustainability_dashboard(db: Session) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from sqlalchemy import func

    result = db.query(
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.total_energy_saved_kwh).label("total_energy_saved_kwh"),
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e).label("total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e"),
        func.avg(SustainabilityMetric.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected).label("average_insulation_efficiency"),
    ).first()

    return {
        "total_energy_saved_kwh": result.total_energy_saved_kwh,
        "total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e": result.total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        "average_insulation_efficiency": result.average_insulation_efficiency,
    }


def record_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    entity_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(
        db,
        action=action,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )


def _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(sustainability.id),
        "reference_id": sustainability.reference_id,
        "reference_kind": sustainability.reference_kind,
        "compliant_with_green_standards": sustainability.compliant_with_green_standards,
        "total_energy_saved_kwh": str(sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh) if sustainability.total_energy_saved_kwh else None,
        "co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e": str(sustainability.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e) if sustainability.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e else None,
        "lifecycle_cost_savings_inr": str(sustainability.lifecycle_cost_savings_inr) if sustainability.lifecycle_cost_savings_inr else None,
        "insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected": str(sustainability.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected) if sustainability.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected else None,
        "insulation_efficiency_status": sustainability.insulation_efficiency_status,
        "payback_period_months": int(sustainability.payback_period_months) if sustainability.payback_period_months is not None else None,
        "measured_at": str(sustainability.measured_at) if sustainability.measured_at else None,
        "notes": sustainability.notes,
        "created_at": str(sustainability.created_at) if sustainability.created_at else None,
        "updated_at": str(sustainability.updated_at) if sustainability.updated_at else None,
    }
